summary: @ornikar/monorepo-config preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute a heavily obfuscated 727KB sibling payload
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs is itself obfuscated (obfuscator.io-style hex identifier renaming and inline dispatch objects hiding references to fs, https, execFileSync, 'ldd', 'musl', 'Alpine', 'bun') and includes a custom ZIP EOCD parser. It downloads the Bun runtime v1.3.13 from oven-sh's GitHub releases, extracts and chmods it, and then invokes the Bun binary against `math_init.js` — a 727KB single-line string-array-rotation obfuscated file bundled with the package (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header, rotating string-array constant, rotator function). Using an alternate runtime pulled at install time to execute a heavily obfuscated sibling defeats Node-focused scanners and hides the payload's behavior. The package advertises itself as monorepo config, which has no legitimate relation to math initialization or a bundled Bun payload. The install-time behavior mismatches the package's stated purpose and obfuscates both the loader and the executed payload.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
